title: The Heavens Declare the Glory of God
summary: The God who commands every sunrise and feeds the birds cares far more for those he shed his blood to save. Let creation remind you of his care.
exhortation: No other god can say what our God says here: "I created every detail of the heavens and the earth." And not only that, he continues to create and sustain it every day. Every time the sun rises, it's because our God commanded it. He didn't just create the wind and the waves. He continues to command and control them. He knows the moon and the stars by name, and they obey him.

And what knowledge can we gain from creation? Jesus tells us in Matthew 6: "Look at the birds of the air: they neither sow nor reap nor gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not of more value than they? ... Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow: they neither toil nor spin, yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these... Therefore do not be anxious."

If the God who created and sustains the world cares about the most insignificant parts of his creation, what does that say about us? We are the ones he loves with an everlasting love, the ones he shed his own blood to save and redeem. He has the power to help us and the love that compels him to. He didn't create us and send us off to figure it out on our own. He continues to sustain us and is involved in every detail of our lives.
So when you look up at the heavens, let them remind you of his care for the details of your life. When you look at the ocean, see his unstoppable love and affection for you, wave after wave.
prayer: Lord, thank you that evidence of your care, kindness and provision for us is everywhere we look, if we will only see it: in all of nature and in the breath in our lungs. You are working to sustain all things and hold all things together. How much more those you purchased with your blood, ransomed and adopted into your family.

Dispel any doubts that are harming your people this morning, any who are questioning your love for them. Some need your sustaining work in their lives right now in a very significant way. Fill them with trust, faith and hope in you today, Lord.
